scope: Two Oblique discovery/review guide stops; no fluent review claimed.

entries.source: With AI access, open Glossy and choose Oblique under AI viewpoint to generate your design.

drafts.zu: Uma ukwazi ukusebenzisa i-AI, vula i-Glossy ukhethe i-Oblique ngaphansi kwe-AI viewpoint ukuze wakhe umdwebo womklamo wakho.
drafts.st: Ha o na le phihlello ya AI, bula Glossy ebe o kgetha Oblique tlasa AI viewpoint ho hlahisa moralo wa hao.
drafts.ts: Loko u ri ni mfikelelo wa AI, pfula Glossy kutani u hlawula Oblique ehansi ka AI viewpoint leswaku u humesa dizayini ya wena.
drafts.ve: Arali ni na tswikelelo ya AI, vulani Glossy ni kone u nanga Oblique fhasi ha AI viewpoint u bveledza pulane yaṋu.

entries.source: Use the top-down Design Map for measurements; compare the angled view with it.

drafts.zu: Sebenzisa i-Design Map ebukwa phezulu ukuze ulinganise; qhathanisa umdwebo obukwa nge-engeli nayo.
drafts.st: Sebedisa Design Map e shebilweng hodimo bakeng sa ditekanyo; bapisa pono ya lehlakoreng le yona.
drafts.ts: Tirhisa Design Map leyi langutiwaka ehenhla eka mimpimo; pimanisa xifaniso xa engele na yona.
drafts.ve: Shumisani Design Map i lavheleswaho nṱha kha mielo; vhambedzani tshifanyiso tsha engele nayo.
